title: Flamethrower on fire
description: This datapack adds a flamethrower and a crafting recepti for it but fore the tecture you also need a resourse pack cald Flamethrower resourse pack
body:
This datapack adds a fully functional flamethrower weapon to Minecraft, designed for players who love high‑tech combat and creative engineering.
It uses custom commands and particle effects to simulate realistic flames, making it ideal for adventure maps, PvP arenas, or survival fun.

🔥 Shoots animated flame particles with damage over time

⚙️ Easy installation and compatible with Minecraft 1.21.4-26.3

🧩 Integrates seamlessly with the resource pack model

Installation:

Place the datapack folder in world/datapacks.

Add the resource pack to your resourcepacks folder.

Run /reload in‑game.

Equip your flamethrower and unleash the fire!
